commands.name: compile-controls
runtime-controls

limits: All previous AMI original-NeMo/HF/native quality failures and20%/2pp criteria remain unchanged.
Previously observed60s smoke fixture, not a new heldout meeting or quality evaluation.
Actual M1 virtual runtime of this exact portableCPU package only; no universal CPU/OS guarantee.
Native children cannot read source SDK/checkout/producer artifacts/build target/helper sources/Cargo/Rustup/Homebrew, and network is denied.
Preparation downloads and dependency bootstrap precede offline native admission. Compiler subprocesses deny model reads/network and writes to package/SDK/source.
Model execution admission includes the public CPU-Metal rejection command; no claim of an exact underlying neural-forward count is made.
Measured RTF/load/push metrics are descriptive shared-VM observations, not uncontended live performance qualification.
No Pnola app/GUI/physical microphone, public signing/notarization, Bark/Laya/chat coexistence or release qualification.

helper_archive.scope: Development filesystem snapshot; preserves aliases/modes, does not by itself close dependencies or establish relocation.

comparison.scope: wrapper/reference correctness at the recorded duration; not held-out quality or full release qualification
